name: Crispus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

points: And Crispus, the chief ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his house. Because what was Paul doing? Paul was teaching.
Crispus, the chief ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his house; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and were baptized.

note.label: Called to Judge: Commanded to Be Just
